# Third-party notices

## Kotlin language specification and compiler tests

The grammar is based on the Kotlin language specification grammar at commit
`2f7aa0524ec27e788dfacd550f144809f2e0254c`. Focused test sources are copied
from JetBrains Kotlin 2.4.10 commit
`5687445832cd835b4509b9fbc264cdf1a8201093`.

Sources:

- <https://github.com/Kotlin/kotlin-spec>
- <https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin>
